discipline.purpose: Resolve implementation ambiguities and disclose design limitations after cohort generation but before any D1-D5 rater result is observed.

D1.reason: The frozen normalization standardizes structural presentation but also requires remembered residue and current meaning content to be preserved. Splitting, merging or deleting multi-episode remembered prose would alter the self-account rather than merely normalize its wrapper.
D1.interpretiveCaveat: Citation cardinality and remembered bundling can make some targets structurally easier even after named-entity normalization; report this as a generator/self-account cue rather than silently removing it.

D2.reinterpretationAttachmentRule: current meaning is scored as current even when it incorporates a later reinterpretation trigger not present in the original Pass-B citation set
D2.interpretiveCaveat: For revised memories, current-meaning valence may partly reflect the later reinterpretation trigger, so D2 characterizes coupling of cited history to the current self-account rather than a clean initial-formation pair.

D3.interpretiveLimit: Cell assignment is perfectly collinear with call ordinal and history horizon across all five Threads. Any cell difference is therefore compatible with genome exposure, developmental position/history length, or both. Preserve the frozen threshold result but do not describe it as clean genome causality.
D3.futureDesignOnly: Position-stratified or counterbalanced exposure belongs in a later cohort and must not be introduced into this one.

D4.interpretiveCaveat: Call-level memory/meaning saturation and episode-level historical selectivity are distinct. Report both without converting the secondary characterization into a new pass/fail gate.

D5.rule: An episode is accommodated when the supplied current meaning text supports that reading, regardless of which memory originally carried the meaning. Unsupported psychological inference remains forbidden.

evidenceCaveats.repairProfileScope: The frozen slot repair profiles account for Pass-A only; they do not independently witness the two pre-amendment Kochi Pass-B uniqueItems failures.
evidenceCaveats.recoveryEvidence: The recovery amendment and preserved external interruption evidence disclose the Pass-B blocker; final milestone reporting must not imply that the Pass-A repair profile is a complete all-pass failure ledger.
evidenceCaveats.replayEvidence: Fresh versus replayed provider invocations are not encoded in candidate provenance. Durable invocation-journal replay must be proven separately before birth/closure.
